transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. We're here to settle the change request for retiring the legacy CI runner image and moving all repositories to the replacement image. The replacement has passed the standard build, integration, and security smoke tests as of today, June 14. The draft proposal is to disable the legacy image on June 21. Before I can approve this, I need release engineering and security compliance to state any blockers or required controls. Let's hear from release engineering first — any blockers or controls on your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to raise a blocker. While handling a failed build this morning, I confirmed that the Atlas and Birch repositories still require a compiler that is only available in the legacy image. Their migration work will take exactly 10 business days. I haven't updated the change request yet because the migration estimate was only confirmed this morning. This means the June 21 disable date is not feasible — we'd need to push it out by at least 10 business days to complete the Atlas and Birch migrations first.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a required control to state. During a compliance evidence review yesterday, I confirmed that every production CI build using the replacement image must emit signed provenance records retained for exactly 365 days before the legacy image can be retired. I haven't filed the control update yet because the evidence review is still being reconciled, but this is a hard requirement that must be in place before retirement proceeds.
